entries.data.stage.s1.hint: Deploy on the path and block. Two melee fighters hold a lane.
entries.data.stage.s1.narrative.clear_debrief: Holding the line gives investigators time to recover a damaged evacuation seal. The pumps stay in service, and Company 33 confirms that the old order never ended.
entries.data.stage.s1.narrative.clue: Every attacking machine carries a two-hundred-year-old Great Flare evacuation mark.
entries.data.stage.s1.narrative.defeat_debrief: Company 33 evacuates the exposed water works. People survive, but Hearthcross loses service capacity before the order can be traced.
entries.data.stage.s1.narrative.human_reason: The town's pumps feed homes, shelters, and fields.
entries.data.stage.s1.narrative.objective: Hold the Hearthcross water-works line while investigators trace the evacuation order carried by the attackers.
entries.data.stage.s1.narrative.threat: Road-clearing Grunts treat people and barricades as blockages.
entries.data.stage.s1.title: First Stand
entries.data.stage.s2.hint: Runners rush early — start with a Shock Trooper or the lane will break.
entries.data.stage.s2.narrative.clear_debrief: The defense keeps the stores open long enough to prove that the Custodians are following a broken clock.
entries.data.stage.s2.narrative.clue: The attack timestamps repeat Blue Noon instead of advancing with the present day.
entries.data.stage.s2.narrative.defeat_debrief: The stores close under evacuation pressure. Company 33 preserves people but loses supplies and the clean timing record.
entries.data.stage.s2.narrative.human_reason: Medicine and food move through these stores.
entries.data.stage.s2.narrative.objective: Hold the route stores while command compares the Runners' repeating arrival times.
entries.data.stage.s2.narrative.threat: Runners carry access tokens and arrive on an old emergency timetable.
entries.data.stage.s2.title: Tempo
entries.data.stage.s3.hint: A one-tile choke: a Spike Plate there pays for itself three times.
entries.data.stage.s3.narrative.clear_debrief: The defense buys the required time. The column escapes before Company 33 gives up the Old Cut; the landmark is lost, the people are not.
entries.data.stage.s3.narrative.clue: Their route checks all point below the surface.
entries.data.stage.s3.narrative.defeat_debrief: Company 33 abandons the Old Cut early. Survivors escape, but more supplies are left behind.
entries.data.stage.s3.narrative.human_reason: A controlled loss saves residents and vital supplies from a worse encirclement.
entries.data.stage.s3.narrative.objective: Hold the Old Cut long enough for the last people and carts to clear; the landmark will still be relinquished.
entries.data.stage.s3.narrative.threat: Custodians press one narrow route and treat the crossing as an obstruction.
entries.data.stage.s3.title: The Choke
entries.data.stage.s4.hint: Drones ignore your blockers. Only Snipers answer the air.
entries.data.stage.s4.narrative.clear_debrief: The defense gives signal crews time to break the link before the shelter list transmits.
entries.data.stage.s4.narrative.clue: The network treats a person remaining on the surface as proof of shock or contamination.
entries.data.stage.s4.narrative.defeat_debrief: The squad drives off the raid too late to stop every mark. Hearthcross must relocate exposed shelters.
entries.data.stage.s4.narrative.human_reason: Marked shelters become targets for the damaged evacuation network.
entries.data.stage.s4.narrative.objective: Hold the shelter approach while signal crews break the Drone survey link.
entries.data.stage.s4.narrative.threat: Drones count survivors and mark positions from above.
entries.data.stage.s4.title: Air Raid
entries.data.stage.s5.hint: Spellcasters cluster tight. One Bolt at the right cell erases a wave.
entries.data.stage.s5.narrative.clear_debrief: The secured interval yields a memory fragment: the Custodians are not one mind, and damaged public orders disagree inside the network.
entries.data.stage.s5.narrative.clue: A damaged stored memory repeats that the surface is still a fatal emergency zone.
entries.data.stage.s5.narrative.defeat_debrief: The relay burns out before the full record is recovered. Company 33 keeps only a partial warning.
entries.data.stage.s5.narrative.human_reason: The relay may explain why public machines are attacking the people they once served.
entries.data.stage.s5.narrative.objective: Hold the ridge relay while Company 33 records the stored message inside it.
entries.data.stage.s5.narrative.threat: Spellcasters retune shared systems and cover one another around the relay.
entries.data.stage.s5.title: High Ground
entries.data.stage.s6.hint: You cannot afford to fight every heavy. Charm the leader and let it break its own wave.
entries.data.stage.s6.narrative.clear_debrief: The defense gives command one clean override window. The route opens briefly; the record confirms coercion over a resisting stored memory, not willing defection.
entries.data.stage.s6.narrative.clue: Charm is a forced override: the affected Custodian keeps signaling resistance, so the command is neither consent nor repair.
entries.data.stage.s6.narrative.defeat_debrief: The evacuation chain remains active. Company 33 withdraws knowing the override cannot be mistaken for consent.
entries.data.stage.s6.narrative.human_reason: Without the route, people and supplies cannot reach the Deep Gate safely.
entries.data.stage.s6.narrative.objective: Hold the repeater approach while command tests whether a forced override can interrupt the evacuation chain.
entries.data.stage.s6.narrative.threat: Heavies protect the repeater while damaged orders resist interruption.
entries.data.stage.s6.title: Turncoat
entries.data.stage.s7.hint: Everything at once. Spend every tool you own, on time.
entries.data.stage.s7.narrative.clear_debrief: The defense gets the assigned medicine and seed through. Testimony remains lost; the result is fixed story context, not an unimplemented player choice.
entries.data.stage.s7.narrative.clue: The missing termination command should have ended the evacuation two centuries ago.
entries.data.stage.s7.narrative.defeat_debrief: The convoy escapes with fewer vital stores. Company 33 records exactly what could not be saved.
entries.data.stage.s7.narrative.human_reason: Medicine, seed, and testimony protect different parts of Hearthcross's future, but this operation begins after command has made the fixed sacrifice.
entries.data.stage.s7.narrative.objective: Hold the convoy route while the assigned medicine and seed loads move; testimony has already been left behind.
entries.data.stage.s7.narrative.threat: Mixed Custodian roles pressure every approach and punish delay.
entries.data.stage.s7.title: Full Kit
entries.data.stage.s8.hint: The Gatecrasher is charm-immune. Mastery, not the panic button.
entries.data.stage.s8.narrative.clear_debrief: The victory creates the opening command needs: the false rules are broken, Goa Wey's surviving record enters custody, and Hearthcross opens the Deep Gate by choice.
entries.data.stage.s8.narrative.clue: Goa Wey remembers Blue Noon, delay, and loss, but her damaged record no longer knows when the emergency ends.
entries.data.stage.s8.narrative.defeat_debrief: Company 33 withdraws. The Deep Gate remains under forced-evacuation authority, and Hearthcross prepares another attempt.
entries.data.stage.s8.narrative.human_reason: Hearthcross must be free to choose whether to descend; permanent emergency rule cannot replace consent.
entries.data.stage.s8.narrative.objective: Hold the Gate approach while command challenges Goa Wey's false emergency authority and shuts down the Gatecrasher proxy.
entries.data.stage.s8.narrative.threat: Goa Wey's evacuation authority closes routes and treats refusal as contamination.
entries.data.stage.s8.title: The Gatecrasher
